profile.name: HP 437B射频功率计
profile.description: HP 437B是一款台式射频/微波功率计，用于配合功率传感器测量射频信号功率。它支持清零、校准、量程控制以及线性/对数单位显示，常用于射频与微波实验中测量信号源输出功率、器件插入损耗和系统功率水平。
profile.description_en: The HP 437B is a benchtop RF/microwave power meter used with power sensors to measure RF signal power. It supports zeroing, calibration, range control, and linear/logarithmic unit display, and is commonly used in RF and microwave labs to measure source output power, insertion loss, and general power levels in test setups.
